maddeler.e:
تستلفون (form VIII)
# تَسْتَلِفُونَ (tastalifūna) /tas.ta.li.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# تُسْتَلَفُونَ (tustalafūna) /tus.ta.la.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
